title: The same filtering view with security_barrier is a boundary, and L12 stays silent

expect.note: the view still executes as its owner — that is what it is for — so the definer-view reach edge is still reported; only the question of *which* rows is settled by the barrier

fix: Nothing on the barrier. This case is case 33 after its fix, and exists to pin that L12 stops firing once the row filter is a boundary rather than a convenience.
